author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! I was expecting some backtracking this week from Sony but it seems my favourite hobby is actually coming to an end as collecting my games and an entire aspect of gaming itself is coming to an end. It seems the future is one that we don't control or own so all we can do now is make the best of this situation. How? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: Its Over For Playstation Going Forward...
